title: How do I limit the number of contributions?
intent: This article explains how to set a maximum number of contributions for a survey.
short_answer: Set a maximum total contributions in Properties. Once reached, new respondents see a custom message or redirect. Configure the limit value and the message displayed when capacity is full.
procedure: Configure the message or link for when limit is reached.
important_conditions: Applies to total contributions across all respondents.
Custom message or redirect link configurable.
Limit checked on each submission attempt.
Per-user limits are a separate setting (allowedContributionsPerUser).
troubleshooting: Respondents blocked: Check if test submissions count toward limit.
related_articles: ES-012 — How do respondents submit a contribution?
ES-007 — How do I configure survey properties?
